text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during a stroll around the
academy, I come across a crowd of
onlookers gathered
around an elegant
group of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, McQueen, before I forget about
the
massage oil I promised you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It finally arrived from home, so would
you come
pick it up from my room later?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Thank you very much. I was looking
for a
good product to massage with after
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's important to take good care of your
body.
That way, you'll never have
anything to regret.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And with the nice fragrance, I believe
it'll help
you to relax. It was specially
made by a perfumer
I'm acquainted with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful! Self-care can often
become a little boring, but a lovely
fragrance can help
make it a truly
therapeutic experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The hair oil I use has an exceptionally
wonderful scent. The hairdresser who
visits our home is the
one who prepares
it, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My hair turns all frizzy without it!
I have
no choice
but to toil over its care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I like how wavy and soft your hair
normally is,
Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You think so? I've always wanted silky,
straight
hair like yours, Dober. Do you
use a special hair
oil?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose. It's what they send to
me from
home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you guys! The only scented thing I
use is
probably my deodorant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me! Ryan, do you use a
specific
brand? I'd like to match with
you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow... The Mejiros sure are different.
Do you
know any perfumers personally?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Of course I don't. But I buy their
conversation. Whenever Mejiros are
near, something sweet
wafts through the
air!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I just got back from the sale, and wow, it
was
packed. I don't smell like sweat, do
I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... you're fine. Did you have a good

shopping trip?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and hear this! I saw the hoodie I
had my
eyes on for half off, but then I
checked out the
size, and...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Squee! Palmer has to be my favorite,
though!
She's so easy to get along with!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! She really stands out when
she's
with the other Mejiros. It's so cool!
